texts.sv_au_denied: Only the owner, an auditor or the accountant can open the audit viewer.
texts.sv_au_intro: Every event of this account. Each look at this page is recorded.
texts.sv_bc_cost: This will use {n} text messages, which cost money. Check before you send.
texts.sv_bc_intro: One urgent message to a whole group, on the channel each person uses.
texts.sv_bc_limits: Up to {chars} characters. {left} of {per_day} left today.
texts.sv_bc_owner_or_manager: Only the owner or a manager can send an urgent message.
texts.sv_bc_seen_how: Seen means opened in the LynkOmni app. Email and text opens are never tracked.
texts.sv_bc_why_per_day: You have sent today's urgent messages. You can send more tomorrow.
texts.sv_bin_intro: Deleted items wait here for {days} days, then they are removed for good.
texts.sv_bin_never: Issued invoices, credit notes, ledger entries, payments, votes, signed documents and anything under legal hold are never deleted.
texts.sv_box_bills_help: A forwarded bill becomes a draft bill. Someone completes it and someone else approves it.
texts.sv_box_cvs_help: A forwarded CV becomes a job application.
texts.sv_box_files_help: A forwarded document is filed with your documents.
texts.sv_cal_intro: Dates from every service in one place. Bookings, leave, tasks, shifts, rent and school fees join as their services arrive.
texts.sv_cs_channels: Contacts who agreed to hear from you
texts.sv_cs_links_help: These links need your consent. Switch one off and every service stops using it at once.
texts.sv_cs_none: You share nothing with others right now.
texts.sv_cs_shared_help: Who can see your data, what they see and until when.
texts.sv_ct_intro: One list for every service. Names and contact details are kept in the protected vault.
texts.sv_ei_allowed: Only {n} senders you allowed get through. Anything else waits here for you.
texts.sv_ei_held_help: From a sender you have not allowed yet.
texts.sv_ei_intro: Forward an email to one of these addresses and it lands in the right place.
texts.sv_hint_bc_text: Example: We open at 10:00 today because of the rain.
texts.sv_hint_mw_text: Example: Thank you for shopping at {business}. See you soon!
texts.sv_mi_empty: Nothing is waiting for this role.
texts.sv_mi_ev_booking: A customer is waiting at the desk
texts.sv_mi_ev_queue: The queue is longer than usual
texts.sv_mi_intro: Alerts for a role land here once. Whoever takes one is shown to the others, and Done clears it for everyone.
texts.sv_mr_intro: How your messages did, as totals.
texts.sv_mr_privacy: Totals only, shown from {n} up. Nothing is shown about any one person.
texts.sv_mw_intro: Change the words of a customer message. Security, safety and legal messages always keep their standard words.
texts.sv_mw_languages: Your words are translated into every language when you save. A language that fails its check keeps the standard words.
texts.sv_mw_limits: Up to {chars} characters. Fill-ins: {fills}. Always keep {must}.
texts.sv_mw_owner_approves: Only the owner approves new wording.
texts.sv_mw_owner_or_manager: Only the owner or a manager can change message wording.
texts.sv_mw_testing: Test mode: only you get this message until you approve it.
texts.sv_mw_why_missing: Keep {business} in the words, so people know who it is from.
texts.sv_mw_why_not_allowed: A message never carries a PIN, a password, a code, a card number or a web link.
texts.sv_mw_why_too_long: This is too long. Make it shorter.
texts.sv_mw_why_unknown: Use only the fill-ins listed below.
texts.sv_owner_only: Only the owner can change this.
texts.sv_pl_intro: Each plan with its limits, and how much is used.
texts.sv_tc_intro: Try connections and automations safely: sample data, every partner in practice mode, no message sent to anyone and no money moved.
texts.sv_tc_on: Test copy open. Messages to customers are off here.
